verdict.rationale: AMD's product spec sheet documents a hardware AV1 encoder and decoder on the RX 9070 XT, which covers part of the media-engine story. Nothing in the pack documents HEVC encoding, creator-app acceleration (e.g., editing or streaming software), or depth beyond a one-line spec, and AMD makes no ISV-certified driver claim for this card here. Missing for 10: HEVC/H.264 encoder documentation, creator-application acceleration details, encoder quality/performance documentation, independent hands-on corroboration of the media engine.

support.subject: As a creator, hardware media engines and creator-app acceleration are documented — AV1/HEVC encoders, and professional or ISV-certified driver support where the vendor claims it

citations.quote: AV1 Decode Yes AV1 Encode Yes
